lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 distinct, thin vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with the most anterior line separated from the mid-torso group by a wider gap (~15% of torso width).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Most lines exhibit discontinuity; specifically, the line located on the posterior flank is truncated, terminating before reaching the dorsal ridge, and appearing as a dashed segment.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, positioned superior to the hind leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-posterior haunch exhibit horizontal alignment, while three lower spots form a loose triangular cluster.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral, lyrate trajectory, curving posteriorly and laterally from the base before angling inward and upward toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.7 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; extensive white/grey dorsal mane and ventral fringe.
